  - Seasonal patterns export button

- Integrated ExportProgressDialog with job polling and auto-download

1. User clicks export button → handleOpenExportDialog called

4. Export mutation called with onSuccess callback
5. On success, onExportStart called with jobId → handleExportComplete triggered
6. ExportDialog closes, ExportProgressDialog opens
7. Progress dialog polls job status and shows progress
8. On completion, auto-downloads file
9. User can re-download or close
